messages:
Ana: Heads-up — pulling the weekly KPI deck now, need a quick decision on the attribution window for the webinar launch. Can we sync in this thread?
Mike: quick Q — is last week's drop in MQLs real or sampling noise? dashboard shows ~18% drop on paid channels.
Sophia: I pulled the cohort view: https://app.redwood.io/dashboards/marketing/kpis-weekly — filter 'webinar_sept_launch' has the raw numbers.
Ryan: I think it's a UTM bug — noticed gclid and utm_campaign got stripped on redirect after the CDN change. Debugging now.
Olivia: For webinars do we prefer 7d, 14d, or 30d attribution? longer catches multi-touch but delays signal.
Ana: Marketing ops suggested 14d for events historically, but in our pre-launch test a 28d window captured meaningful downstream trials.
Mike: Also need to pick an attribution model for the weekly readout: last-click or position-based? leaning position-based to credit content/webinar.
Sophia: +1 position-based. Last-click is overweighting retargeting in reports.
Ryan: FYI raw event chain we're seeing: ```ga_session_start -> page_view -> form_submit -> trial_start``` — last-click pins control to the retargeting click too often.
Olivia: Can we add a 'UTM-fix' tag to the launch backlog and bump it to high priority? @devops please.
LaunchBot: Deploy succeeded: campaign-landing-v2 (redirect fix rollback) — 2024-09-12T14:22Z :white_check_mark:
Mike: Numbers from the deck snapshot: webinar signups 1,220 (promo email cohort), signups->MQL conversion 9.2% vs target 12%.
Sophia: Channel breakdown on the dashboard: email conv 9.2%, paid social 6.1%, organic search 11.7% (organic has smaller volume).
Ryan: If we switch to position-based attribution and 14d window, webinar-driven MQLs increase ~18% in the model I just ran locally.
Ana: Action items: 1) Ops to re-run KPI deck with 14d and 28d windows and both last-click and position-based outputs; 2) Dev to patch UTM redirect (Ryan owns) and confirm; 3) Analytics to add a sample-rate note on the dashboard (GA sampling hit 0.5% during peak).
Olivia: I'll take point on the A/B for email subject lines and update the cohort after 48h.
Mike: Can we have the re-run and slides by EOD tomorrow? I want updated graphs for the weekly metric review.
Sophia: Will add a small table in the deck showing absolute MQL deltas by channel under each model.
Ryan: UTM redirect fix deployed to staging, validating now. ETA to prod tonight if no regressions.
Ana: Great — once re-run is in, I'll summarize the ask for leadership: recommend position-based, default 14d for webinar-led campaigns, and note the sampling caveat.
Olivia: dropping quick thumbs when you've completed your part please :thumbsup: 
Mike: :eyes: adding to my calendar block to review final deck.
LaunchBot: Reminder: weekly-kpi-report scheduled in #marketing on 2024-09-13 10:00 UTC.
Sophia: Done — re-run queued, will post updated link here when complete.
Ryan: UTM fix is live to prod, confirmed utm params persist through redirect.
Olivia: A/B draft ready, will fire first variant tomorrow morning.
Ana: Thanks team — keep updates in this thread so I can pull notes into the leadership summary.
